refs.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer.

points.conflict: Floor (_007) gives exactly the 6 gold disputes (steps 2-7). required_documents omits _007; half-up flags 22 extra rows, e.g. txn_e45e7acb56a0 90 vs 89.
